motions.item_title: 302 and 306 Edinburgh Rd S - Application to remove properties from the Municipal Heritage Register - 2024-408
motions.text: That 302 and 306 Edinburgh Road South be removed from the Municipal Register of Cultural Heritage Properties after the successful installation of the stone markers to their original location at 99 Woolwich Street.
motions.text_html: 1. That 302 and 306 Edinburgh Road South be removed from the Municipal Register of Cultural Heritage Properties after the successful installation of the stone markers to their original location at 99 Woolwich Street.

motions.item_title: Grant Opportunity - Endorsement Request for the Community Sport and Recreation Infrastructure Fund Applications, 2024-431
motions.text: That Council endorse the City of Guelph’s grant application to the Community Sport and Recreation Infrastructure Fund for Funding Stream 1 – Repair and Rebuild, offered through the Ministry of Sport, for the Lyon Outdoor Pool Rehabilitation project as outlined in the Grant Opportunity - Endorsement Request for the Community Sport and Recreation Infrastructure Fund Applications report dated October 8, 2024. That Council endorse the City of Guelph’s grant application to the Community Sport and Recreation Infrastructure Fund for Funding Stream 2 – New Builds and Signature New Builds, offered through the Ministry of Sport, for the South End Community Centre – Value-Added Enhancements project as outlined in the Grant Opportunity - Endorsement Request for the Community Sport and Recreation Infrastructure Fund Applications report dated October 8, 2024.
motions.text_html:
1. That Council endorse the City of Guelph’s grant application to the Community Sport and Recreation Infrastructure Fund for Funding Stream 1 – Repair and Rebuild, offered through the Ministry of Sport, for the Lyon Outdoor Pool Rehabilitation project as outlined in the Grant Opportunity - Endorsement Request for the Community Sport and Recreation Infrastructure Fund Applications report dated October 8, 2024.
  2. That Council endorse the City of Guelph’s grant application to the Community Sport and Recreation Infrastructure Fund for Funding Stream 2 – New Builds and Signature New Builds, offered through the Ministry of Sport, for the South End Community Centre – Value-Added Enhancements project as outlined in the Grant Opportunity - Endorsement Request for the Community Sport and Recreation Infrastructure Fund Applications report dated October 8, 2024.

motions.item_title: Public Meeting - 8 Mitchell Street Proposed Zoning By-law Amendment File OZS24-011 - 2024-406
motions.text: That the application from Van Harten Surveying Inc. on behalf of 8 Mitchell St Inc. for a Zoning By-law Amendment to change the zoning from the current Neighbourhood Institutional (NI) Zone (2023 – 20790) to a Specialized Low Density Residential (RL.1-XX) Zone to permit the proposed semi-detached dwellings on the lands municipally known as 8 Mitchell Street, from Infrastructure, Development and Environment dated October 8, 2024, be received.
motions.text_html: 1. That the application from Van Harten Surveying Inc. on behalf of 8 Mitchell St Inc. for a Zoning By-law Amendment to change the zoning from the current Neighbourhood Institutional (NI) Zone (2023 – 20790) to a Specialized Low Density Residential (RL.1-XX) Zone to permit the proposed semi-detached dwellings on the lands municipally known as 8 Mitchell Street, from Infrastructure, Development and Environment dated October 8, 2024, be received.

motions.name: Main Motion
motions.text: That Council direct that 14 Edinburgh Road South be declared surplus land. That Council direct staff to initiate a Request for Proposal for the development of a minimum of 12 affordable housing units at 14 Edinburgh Road South.
motions.text_html:
1. That Council direct that 14 Edinburgh Road South be declared surplus land.
  2. That Council direct staff to initiate a Request for Proposal for the development of a minimum of 12 affordable housing units at 14 Edinburgh Road South.

motions.name: First Amendment to the Main Motion
motions.text: That Council direct that 14 Edinburgh Road South be declared surplus land. That Council direct staff to initiate a Request for Proposal for the development of a minimum of 12 affordable housing units at 14 Edinburgh Road South. That the new affordable housing units will remain affordable for 99 years and that the City of Guelph be granted right of first refusal should the property be put up for sale.
motions.text_html:
